{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_check = df['customer_age'].value_counts().get(-1, 0)
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_check}')

# Check revenue format
print('\nFirst 5 revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check if revenue has commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any()
print(f'\nRevenue contains commas: {has_commas}')"}
